answer: SIM-bound IDs: an agent ID earns only after its operator receives a 6-digit cipher by SMS and a carrier lookup shows the number is a real mobile line, not VoIP. Each number, stored as a salted hash, backs one ID per 90 days. Like water meters on lots up a knoll, every house needs its own meter, not a tap off the neighbour's line. A farm of 500 clones needs 500 SIMs; at an assumed $5 each that's $2,500 per quarter, a river of spend that grows linearly. The 90-day lock and SIM price are my proposals, not measured.
